title: 第5章 师尊你也不想天魔之体的事情被别人第6章 跟师尊贴贴就能减轻魔性
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
“那好，等会儿我吃的时候你别眼馋！”
江尘羽无所谓地耸了耸肩，慢条斯理地从储物袋中将一盒包装得十分精美的糕点给拿了出来。
在糕点包装被撕开的瞬间，一股清甜而不腻味的香气顿时就扑散开了！
而也是在这时，少女的喉咙又动了一下，双腿也不自觉地跟着摆动一二。
作为太一清宗的天才，独孤傲霜的待遇自然也不错。
外加上魔头江尘羽的投喂，这妮子从小到大的灵宝确实没有苦着。
但那仅仅只限于修行上的宝物，像是吃喝玩乐之类的，独孤傲霜也确实没有享受过。
身上穿的衣服，在十八岁之前永远是宗门派发下来的弟子服。
直到后来，独孤傲霜成为年轻一辈最出名的顶级天才之一，在宗门的要求下才换上了好看的衣裳。
但也仅仅只有几件。
至于吃的，她更是没有享受过什么高档的。
在同龄天才都在山珍海味大鱼大肉之时，她却在啃着修行丹药。
为了能早日超过魔头师尊，将他给狠狠践踏击杀，这妮子辟谷丹从年头磕到年尾，就是为了省下修炼的时间。
“嗯，味道真不错！你确定不来点吗？”
待炫了两三块糕点后，江尘羽满意地点了点头。
谁说这修真界的东西难吃来的？这味道真是太棒了！
“不要，这种东西，我怎么可能会稀罕......”
“咕噜～”
少女继续吞咽着唾沫，但是在江尘羽没有主动递过去之前，她不会主动开口讨要。
毕竟，她最讨厌的就是欠魔头师尊的人情。

若非她是奄奄一息地被江尘羽从坟头拽出来送到仙宗里头，欠了一份天大的恩情，那她早就揭发江尘羽那卑劣的行径，让他身败名裂了！
“真不要还是假不要？”
江尘羽挑了挑自己的眉头，随后神色变得稍微凶狠了些，展露出江魔头的几分神色。
“真不要！”
少女鼻子动了下，发出了一声轻哼，随后将脑袋再度别开，让那些散发着迷人芳醇的糕点从自己视野里消失。
“除非......”
又过了两三息，脾气傲，身材更是一顶一傲人的大徒弟又用近乎微不可闻的声音在他的耳边呢喃道。
“除非什么？”
江尘羽好奇。
“除非师尊下命令，命令我吃这些糕点！”
少女说完这话，也是觉得自己有些太过离谱。
content_en:
"Okay, don't be greedy when I eat it later!"
Jiang Chenyu shrugged indifferently and slowly took out a box of beautifully packaged pastries from the storage bag.
The moment the pastry packaging was torn open, a sweet but not greasy aroma immediately spread out!
At this time, the girl's throat moved again, and her legs swayed unconsciously.
As a genius of the Taiyi Qing Sect, Dugu Aoshuang was naturally treated well.
Coupled with the feeding of the devil Jiang Chenyu, this girl's spiritual treasure has really not suffered since she was a child.
But those were only treasures for cultivation, such as eating, drinking and having fun, and Dugu Aoshuang had indeed never enjoyed them.
The clothes he wears will always be the disciple uniforms distributed by the sect before he turns eighteen.
It was not until later that Dugu Aoshuang became one of the most famous top geniuses of the younger generation, and she changed into beautiful clothes at the request of the sect.
But only a few pieces.
As for food, she has never enjoyed anything high-end.
While the geniuses of the same age were feasting on delicacies, fish and meat, she was chewing on pills for cultivation.
In order to surpass the demon master as soon as possible and trample him to death, this girl took Bigu Pill from the beginning of the year to the end of the year just to save time in practice.
"Well, it tastes really good! Are you sure you don't want some?"
After showing off two or three pastries, Jiang Chenyu nodded with satisfaction.
Who said the food from the world of cultivation is unpalatable? This tastes amazing!
"No, how could I be so rare about this kind of thing..."
"Gulu~"
The girl continued to swallow her saliva, but she would not take the initiative to ask for it until Jiang Chenyu handed it over.
After all, what she hated most was the favor she owed to the Demon Master.
If she hadn't been dragged out of the grave by Jiang Chenyu and sent to the Immortal Sect while she was dying, and she owed a huge debt of gratitude, she would have exposed Jiang Chenyu's despicable behavior and ruined his reputation!
"Really or falsely don't want it?"
Jiang Chenyu raised his eyebrows, and then his expression became a little more fierce, showing a bit of Demon Jiang's expression.
"I really don't want it!"
The girl's nose moved and she let out a soft snort. Then she turned her head away again, letting the charming and fragrant pastries disappear from her sight.
"Unless..."
After another two or three breaths, the eldest disciple, who had an arrogant temperament and an even more impressive figure, whispered in his ear again in an almost inaudible voice.
"Unless what?"
Jiang Chenyu was curious.
"Unless Master gives an order to order me to eat these cakes!"
After the girl said this, she felt that she was a little too outrageous.
